thesis: The episode introduces Doug Colkitt, an ex-high-frequency trader and founder of CrocSwap, who discusses his career progression from Citadel to building independent high-frequency systems and MEV strategies. He explains that he chose to trade equity futures instead of equities because futures trade at a single venue, simplifying the infrastructure requirements for a solo operator compared to the complex multi-venue setup needed for equities.
